description: The Icelandic Radio Amateurs society, ÍRA, lists the VHF and UHF repeaters, digipeaters and internet gateways, and VHF beacons that are available to radio amateurs in Iceland. The VHF repeaters are named by call sign and site, such as TF1RPB at Bláfjöll, TF1RPE at Búrfell, TF2RPJ at Mýrar, TF3RPA and TF3RPK at Skálafell and TF5RPD at Vaðlaheiði; the UHF list includes the D-STAR digital repeater TF3RPI at Bláfjöll and an FM link at Bláfjöll tied to TF2RPJ. Digipeaters and internet gateways are listed with coordinates, for example TF1APA at Búrfell, TF1APB at Reynisfjall, TF8APA at Grindavík and TF5SS at Akureyri, and the beacons are TF1VHF on 50 and 70 MHz at Álftanes á Mýrum. The page notes that the Bláfjöll site is 690 metres above sea level. Access is free and public; no licence is stated. Caveats: the list was posted in September 2022 and gives sites, not frequencies for most repeaters, and it is in Icelandic. Coverage is Iceland. It supports emergency communications planning, such as knowing which mountain relay sites can carry backup radio traffic when mobile networks fail during eruptions or storms; related records are the NRRL Norway repeater list and the Icelandic infrastructure asset inventory.
